answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: a caught fake's address becomes a permanent on-chain tombstone. When a jury proves an identity fake, its key is burned forever: no re-entry, stake forfeited, history frozen in the vault. This kills identity recycling. Normally an attacker churns caught addresses and reuses their reputation; here each detection is a total write-off, so the expected cost per fake carries the full loss. No climbing back, only a fresh key at zero. Detection becomes a ridge no burned identity re-crosses; a fake's stake vanishes at the first whisper of a verdict.
